rejected.title: Bootstrapped and Need AWS
rejected.reason: The assigned HN request says bootstrapped startups need help scaling on AWS but cannot afford it. This is a broad service need, not a concrete bounded chore with task steps or inputs. No relevant implementation reference is supplied, so a useful experiment would require inventing duties. Excluded without scoring.

steps.message: The only assigned discussion describes a broad need for affordable AWS scaling help, without a concrete task to prototype. Excluded rather than inventing a workflow or payer evidence; no post proposed.
